com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security
Resource server security configuration (JWT or opaque-token validation, method security, RFC 6750 error handling).
  • Classes in com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security used by com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security
    Class
    Description
    StepUpAccessDeniedHandler
    Answers a StepUpRequiredDecision with 401 and the RFC 9470 challenge (error="insufficient_user_authentication" with the required acr_values and max_age); every other denial goes to the delegate, the RFC 6750 handler.
    StepUpAuthorizationManager
    Requires that the bearer token proves a recent strong authentication (RFC 9470): its acr claim must be one of the configured (space-separated) values and its auth_time claim no older than the configured maximum age.
    StepUpProperties
    Step-up authentication policy (RFC 9470) of the sensitive operations, bound from resourceserver.step-up.*.
